formal_statement: ∃ (x1 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp) (x2 : Fin (26 : ℕ)) (x3 : Fin (26 : ℕ)) (x4 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit),   (x1 = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.and ∨ x1 = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.or) ∧     (x2, x3) ∈ [((0 : Fin (26 : ℕ)), (1 : Fin (26 : ℕ))), ((0 : Fin (26 : ℕ)), (13 : Fin (26 : ℕ))), ((0 : Fin (26 : ℕ)), (15 : Fin (26 : ℕ)))] ∧       PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.Monotone2 x4 ∧         x4.size ≤ (62 : ℕ) ∧           let x5 : Fin (13 : ℕ) → Fin (13 : ℕ) → Prop := fun (x5 x6 : Fin (13 : ℕ)) => (↑x5 + ↑x6) % (13 : ℕ) ∈ [(0 : ℕ), (1 : ℕ), (3 : ℕ), (9 : ℕ)];           have x6 : Finset (Fin (13 : ℕ)) → Finset (Fin (13 : ℕ)) → Fin (26 : ℕ) → Bool := fun (x6 x7 : Finset (Fin (13 : ℕ))) (x8 : Fin (26 : ℕ)) => if ↑x8 < (13 : ℕ) then Decidable.decide (Fin.ofNat (13 : ℕ) ↑x8 ∈ x6) else Decidable.decide (Fin.ofNat (13 : ℕ) ↑x8 ∈ x7);           have x7 : Finset (Fin (13 : ℕ)) → Finset (Fin (13 : ℕ)) := fun (x7 : Finset (Fin (13 : ℕ))) => {x8 : Fin (13 : ℕ) | ∀ x9 ∈ x7, ¬x5 x9 x8};           have x8 : Finset (Fin (13 : ℕ)) → Finset (Fin (13 : ℕ)) → Bool := fun (x8 x9 : Finset (Fin (13 : ℕ))) => x4.eval (List.ofFn (x6 x8 x9) ++ [x1.eval [x6 x8 x9 x2, x6 x8 x9 x3]]);           (∀ (x9 x10 : Fin (13 : ℕ)), x5 x9 x10 → x8 {x9} {x10} = Bool.true) ∧ ∀ (x9 : Finset (Fin (13 : ℕ))), x9.card ≤ (3 : ℕ) → x8 x9 (x7 x9) = Bool.false ∧ x8 (x7 x9) x9 = Bool.false
plain_statement: Plane of order 3. For some first gate that is the AND or the OR of inputs (0,1), (0,13) or (0,15), some circuit of AND and OR gates, at most two inputs a gate, with at most 62 gates, on the 26 inputs and that gate's wire, is true at every incident point-line pair and false at every input made of at most three points with all lines missing them, and at every input made of at most three lines with all points off them.
title: A step toward: A step toward: Search: a circuit of AND and OR gates with at most 63 gates for the point-line graph of the projective plane of order 3
